_note: Doorbell cam: officers at a woman's door over a slap accusation. Times in SOURCE seconds. Speakers split by voice pitch; verify before posting.

_beats.0 cold open: Tight on the officer; open on the threat, low hit on BREACH. Hook from the content itself.
_beats.1 how it started: Pull back to wide: the contrast after the tight open re-establishes the scene.
_beats.2 her: Snap to the woman behind the glass: micro-reveal, she's been there all along.
_beats.3 the handle: Tight on his hand: he's already working her door handle while telling her to unlock it.
_beats.4 her again: Quick exchange, so framing follows the voice (rapid reframing).
_beats.5 show me the video: Two-shot; 'video' calls back to his opening claim.
_beats.6 denial: Quiet wide hold; let the denial sit.
_beats.7 force: The one slow push of the setup: escalation.
_beats.8 easy way: Medium; sets up the contrast with the threat 6 s later.
_beats.9 waited hours: Static hold on her; she's talking, nothing to add.
_beats.10 'I know.': 0.6 s tight reaction: dismissive beat, hard cut.
_beats.11 threat: Medium, then a sudden punch-in exactly on 'breach'. No hit this time (no repeats).
_beats.12 seconds later: Wide. She's gone from the glass; the officers talk to each other.
_beats.13 the admission: Slow push on officer 2 up to 'can't'.
_beats.freeze: Silence. First the term is explained alone, then the verdict lands with the second hit.
